question: If Dark Magician of Chaos gets Special Summoned partway through a chain and isn't the last thing to resolve, do I still get a Spell Card back from my Graveyard?
expected: No. If Dark Magician of Chaos is Special Summoned in the middle of a chain, its optional trigger effect misses the timing, so you do not return a Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

question: If I discard Night Assailant to pay for Tribe-Infecting Virus, does Night Assailant's effect go off?
expected: Yes. Night Assailant only has to be sent to the Graveyard, so discarding it as a cost for Tribe-Infecting Virus or Magic Jammer activates its effect, after the current chain resolves.

question: My Sinister Serpent got destroyed during my own Standby Phase. Can I bring it back to my hand right away or do I wait a turn?
expected: You can return it right away. If Sinister Serpent is destroyed on the field during your Standby Phase, you may return it to your hand during that same Standby Phase.

question: My opponent used Nobleman of Crossout on my face-down Sangan. Do I get to search with Sangan?
expected: No. Nobleman of Crossout removes the monster from play so it never goes to the Graveyard, and Sangan's effect does not activate.

question: When Mystic Tomato dies in battle and pulls out another monster, can I respond with Torrential Tribute?
expected: No. Torrential Tribute cannot be activated during the Damage Step, so it cannot be used against monsters Special Summoned by Mystic Tomato and similar cards that summon when destroyed by battle.

question: My opponent activated a Spell Card. Can I chain Breaker the Magical Warrior's effect to it to destroy something?
expected: No. Breaker the Magical Warrior's effect is Spell Speed 1, so you cannot chain it to the activation of a Spell Card.

question: I removed the counter from Breaker to destroy a card and my opponent chained Ring of Destruction on Breaker. How much damage does Ring do, and does Breaker still destroy my target?
expected: Ring of Destruction deals 1600 damage to each player because removing the Spell Counter is a cost and already happened. Breaker's destruction effect still applies even though Breaker has been destroyed.

question: I activated Premature Burial and my opponent chained Imperial Order. Do I get my 800 Life Points back since nothing was summoned?
expected: No. The effect of Premature Burial is negated and the Special Summon never happens, but you still pay the 800 Life Points.

question: With Tribe-Infecting Virus, does my opponent find out which Type I'm hitting before they decide whether to chain?
expected: Yes. You declare the Type when you activate the effect and discard for the cost, not on resolution, so your opponent can chain after knowing which Type will be destroyed.

question: If I take my opponent's Spirit Reaper with Creature Swap, does Spirit Reaper destroy itself?
expected: No. Creature Swap does not target, so it does not cause Spirit Reaper to be destroyed by its own effect.

question: I'm attacking and my opponent flips Mirror Force. If I chain Book of Moon to flip my attacker face-down, does it survive?
expected: Yes. If you chain Book of Moon to your opponent's Mirror Force to flip one of your monsters face-down, that monster is not destroyed by Mirror Force.

question: My opponent's Fiber Jar flipped up and its effect activated. Can I stop it by chaining Book of Moon to turn it back face-down?
expected: No. Book of Moon flips the monster face-down again, but the Flip Effect of a monster like Fiber Jar still resolves as normal.

question: Airknight Parshath attacks a face-down flip monster and deals piercing damage. Which happens first, my draw or the flip effect?
expected: You draw first. When Airknight Parshath attacks a face-down Flip Effect monster and inflicts Battle Damage, you draw 1 card before the Flip Effect is applied.

question: My opponent has a face-up Jinzo. Can I still flip my Sakuretsu Armor when Jinzo attacks?
expected: No. Traps cannot be activated while Jinzo is face-up on the field.

question: I brought back a monster with Premature Burial and my opponent hit it with Book of Moon. Does my monster die too?
expected: No. If the equipped monster is flipped face-down, Premature Burial is destroyed but the monster is not destroyed.

question: Skill Drain is face-up. If my Sangan gets destroyed, can I still search?
expected: Yes. Skill Drain only negates the effects of face-up Effect Monsters on the field, not effects that activate in the Graveyard such as Sangan's.

question: I used Scapegoat this turn. Am I still allowed to Set a monster?
expected: Yes. You can Set a monster in the same turn you activate Scapegoat.

question: Can I attack with Chaos Sorcerer and then use its banish effect in Main Phase 2?
expected: No. If Chaos Sorcerer attacks, you cannot use its effect during Main Phase 2; you can only activate it in Main Phase 2 if it did not attack.

question: If my opponent responds to my Call of the Haunted by destroying it with Mystical Space Typhoon, do I still get my monster?
expected: No. If Call of the Haunted is destroyed in a chain to its own activation, the monster it would Special Summon is not Special Summoned.

question: What happens if Morphing Jar flips up and one of us has only 3 cards left in the Deck?
expected: That player loses the Duel. If either player has fewer than 5 cards in their Deck when Morphing Jar's Flip Effect activates, that player loses because the card says draw.

question: My opponent controls two monsters tied for the highest DEF. When I activate Smashing Ground, who chooses which one gets destroyed?
expected: The rulings in the data do not settle this. No ruling covers how Smashing Ground resolves when monsters are tied for the highest DEF.

question: If Magician of Faith flips up while there are no Spell Cards in my Graveyard, does its effect still activate?
expected: The rulings in the data do not settle this. No ruling covers Magician of Faith's Flip Effect when the Graveyard has no Spell Cards.

question: Does Sakuretsu Armor target the attacking monster?
expected: The rulings in the data do not settle this. No ruling states whether Sakuretsu Armor targets.
